MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The caliper fits my recent fastener purchases because measuring screw diameters and shaft sizes would help me choose bolts and push-on washers that fit.",
    "The step drill bit could support a related mounting job, though I would wait until I actually needed to make holes before choosing it."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Temperature controllers, pH testers, tubing and liquid stirrers require projects I have not shown a need for; they do not help me match fasteners or hang items.",
    "A cable tester and wire connectors assume an electrical task that my hardware purchases do not establish.",
    "Ten tubes of glue feel excessive because I use supplies occasionally and have no immediate adhesive repair."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in practical hardware seems to have been stretched into an interest in almost any workshop or testing equipment.",
    "The magnetic stirrer shares the word magnetic with my hooks, but hanging objects and mixing liquids serve completely different needs."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent washers, bolts and hooks point toward fitting, fastening and hanging tasks, where dimensions and mounting compatibility matter.",
    "I rarely choose something without a concrete use, so a tool being potentially useful is weaker than it helping with a task I already have."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my hardware needs but stretched them into unrelated technical projects instead of focusing on fitting, fastening and hanging."
}
